description: Build the complete frontend: HTML page with dark/fire theme, resume input (paste textarea + file upload), intensity toggle, results renderer with animated roast reveal, roast cards, copy/share/export features, ATS flags panel, and responsive mobile design. All vanilla JS with no build step.
steps: Create public/index.html - Single page app structure with: header (logo + tagline), input section (textarea with character/word count, file upload dropzone accepting .pdf/.docx/.txt, intensity toggle Mild/Medium/Nuclear, optional target role input field, 'Roast My Resume' CTA button disabled until >50 words), results section (hidden initially - score display, headline, top 3 fixes checklist, collapsible sections for each resume section, ATS flags warning panel), share/export section, error state display, loading state with witty messages. Include meta tags for responsive mobile.

Create public/styles.css - Dark mode design with fire/red accent palette (#1a1a2e background, #e94560 fire red, #0f3460 deep blue accents, #16213e card backgrounds). Monospace font for quoted resume text (Fira Code or system monospace). Speech-bubble style for roasts. Green 'rewrite' boxes for fixes. Strikethrough/red highlight for weak text quotes. Responsive design with mobile-first approach. Animated score counter. Fade-in animations. Collapsible sections with smooth transitions. Toggle button group styling. Dropzone with drag-and-drop visual feedback. Loading spinner/skeleton states.

Create public/app.js - ES module vanilla JS that handles: (1) Textarea input with live word count updating CTA button state. (2) File upload via click or drag-and-drop, with file type validation. (3) Intensity toggle state management. (4) Form submission - sends POST to /api/roast with either JSON (paste text) or multipart FormData (file). (5) Loading state with rotating witty messages. (6) Results rendering: animated score count-up, headline fade-in, sections expanding one at a time with staggered delay. (7) Each issue card renders quote (strikethrough/red), roast (speech bubble), why (explanation), fix (green box with copy button). (8) Copy button for individual fixes. (9) Export full report as .md or .txt file (client-side download). (10) Shareable roast card - generates a summary card (score + headline) that can be copied as text for sharing. (11) Error state handling with friendly messages. (12) Collapsible sections per resume area.
Ensure the frontend works fully with just paste-text input even if file parsing has issues - the paste path must never be blocked by file-parsing bugs
Add proper error handling: network failures show 'Our roast machine choked, try again' style messages, rate limit errors show appropriate message, validation errors show specific guidance
acceptance_criteria: Opening index.html in the browser (served by the Node.js server) shows a properly styled dark-theme page
Word count updates in real-time as user types in textarea
CTA button is disabled when textarea has fewer than 50 words
CTA button enables when textarea has 50+ words
Intensity toggle switches between Mild/Medium/Nuclear with visual feedback
File upload accepts .pdf, .docx, .txt files and shows filename
Submitting with text triggers POST to /api/roast and shows loading state
Results render with animated score, headline, expandable sections
Each issue card shows quote, roast, why, and fix in distinct visual styles
Copy buttons work for individual fixes
Mobile responsive - works on narrow viewport without horizontal scroll
Error states show friendly messages, not raw errors
verification: Start the server, open http://localhost:3000 in a browser context and verify static files load
Verify the HTML is valid and all CSS/JS references resolve correctly
Test responsive design by checking CSS media queries exist
